_source: MainApp.exe FUN_004473c0 (decomp/MainApp.c): 11 layer records (stride 0x480) at cfg+0x4ed8 (fiber) and cfg+0x8058 (CO2, identical colours); colour doubles r,g,b read from .rdata 0x833e50/0x834218/0x833f08/0x843690..0x843700. FUN_00449xxx loop (MainApp.c ~133690) copies the 11 records into the CADModule layer vector whose entry colour feeds glColor3d (CADModule.c ~84115). Index = layer index used by Craft.layer. Naming of index 0 (BackLayer vs Layer 1) is inferred, see docs/ui.md.
